question_text: A 65-year-old woman underwent haematopoietic precursor transplant 30 days ago and severe neutropenia. It begins with cough and expectoration hemoptica in addition to fever and dyspnea of ​​moderate efforts that does not improve despite five days of treatment with amoxicillin-clavulanate (875/125 mg / 8 h) and levofloxacin (500 mg / 12 h). Thoracic radiographs show multiple poorly defined pulmonary nodules, some of them cavitated. Among the following, what is the most likely suspected diagnosis?
